name: Pyramid Upper / Lower
description: Four workouts a week for 9 weeks, two upper-body and two lower-body, with the main lifts done as a pyramid: each set heavier and with fewer reps than the last, so the light early sets warm you up and the last set is the heaviest. The other exercises are straight sets. Week 5 is a deload; the second block starts heavier with a shorter pyramid. When the last set reaches its reps, add weight to the whole pyramid next time. Exercises marked optional add arms, shoulders, calves or abs for a longer day; leave them out when short of time.

phases.name: Pyramid 12-10-8-6
phases.description: Four sets on the main lifts: 12, 10, 8 and 6 reps, adding weight every set

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Bodyweight first; add a belt and weight when every set is easy

phases.name: Deload
phases.description: One lighter week: fewer sets and lighter weights, so you start the next phase recovered

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Bodyweight first; add a belt and weight when every set is easy

phases.name: Pyramid 10-8-6-4
phases.description: Heavier: 10, 8, 6 and 4 reps, adding weight every set

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Bodyweight first; add a belt and weight when every set is easy
